route.label: Endless Road
route.description: A solo adventure: walk the road, face random events and earn coins and items.

commands.move: Take a step on the Endless Road.
commands.shop: Buy a provision (instant effect on purchase).

route.noTraveler: 🧭 {user} hasn't hit the road yet (`/route avancer`).
route.leaderboardEmpty: No one has covered any distance yet.
route.cooldown: 😮‍💨 You're tired. You can set off again {time}.

missedGift.lines: 🕳️ …except no. Nothing. Zip. You leave empty-handed.|👁️👄👁️ STARE THIS GUY — promised you a gift, then walked off with it.|🎁➡️💨 The gift existed for about two seconds. Not for you, but it existed.|📦 Parcel lost. The Road's customer service stopped answering 400 years ago.|🤡 You hold out your hands. You receive air. Premium air, admittedly.|🎲 Randomness looked you dead in the eye and said no.|🧾 Out of stock. Come back in another life.|😐 Technically there was a gift. Technically you do not have it.|🚪 He showed you the parcel, smiled, and closed his bag. A classic.|🏆 You win a valuable life lesson. Market value: 0 coins.|🐌 Your gift is on its way. It will probably never arrive.|👏 No gift, but some mocking applause somewhere in the distance.|🧦 He rummaged and rummaged, found a single sock, and kept it.|📉 Your inventory stays exactly as empty as before. Impressive.|🙃 Good news: you lost nothing. Bad news: you gained nothing.|🥲 No gift for you. That is it. That is the whole message.|🪄 The gift turned into dust. Nobody saw that coming.|💀 He tripped and the parcel fell into a ravine. You watched it happen.

route.fainted: 💀 You ran out of strength… you wake at the last camp (distance halved).

stats.title: Traveller status

events.path: 🥾 You walk a peaceful trail and make quiet progress.
events.treasure: 💰 You dig up a forgotten chest full of coins!
events.monster: ⚔️ A creature ambushes you! You fight it off and press on, worse for wear.
events.trap: 🪤 A trap snaps shut on you! You wriggle free.
events.merchant: 🧺 A wandering merchant crosses your path.
events.rest: 🏕️ You make camp and recover your strength.
events.shortcut: 🧭 You find a shortcut and stride ahead!
events.storm: 🌩️ A violent storm slows and exhausts you.
events.friend: 🤝 A fellow traveller shares food and coins with you.
events.abyss: 🕳️ You fall into a chasm… you barely climb out, battered but with full pockets.
events.oasis: 🌴 You stumble upon a hidden oasis and rest in the shade of the palms.
events.ruins: 🏛️ You explore ancient ruins and unearth a few treasures.
events.wolves: 🐺 A wolf pack gives chase! You escape, but not unscathed.
events.river: 🌊 You cross a raging river: exhausting, but you gain ground.
events.shrine: ⛩️ You pray at a mysterious shrine and feel reinvigorated.
events.mirage: 🏜️ A mirage leads you astray, wasting time and strength.
events.bandits: 🗡️ Bandits attack! You fend them off and take their loot.
events.volcano: 🌋 You skirt an erupting volcano: the heat scorches you, but the molten gold is worth it.
events.quicksand: 🏜️ You sink into quicksand! You crawl out exhausted, having lost precious ground.
events.landslide: ⛰️ A landslide sends you tumbling down the slope! You have to climb all the way back.
events.lost: 🌫️ A thick fog leads you completely astray… you unknowingly retrace your steps.
events.bog: 🐸 You get stuck in a stinking bog and waste ages pulling yourself free.
events.ravine: 🧗 You slip into a ravine and climb back out, bruised and demoralised.
events.curse: 💀 An ancient curse strikes you and hurls you violently backwards!
events.echo: ⏳ A time echo sends you far back… yet you feel strangely rested.
events.thief: 🦹 A pickpocket lifts some of your coins and vanishes!
events.gambler: 🎲 A gambler challenges you to a dice game: win or lose, fate decides.
events.sphinx: 🦁 A sphinx asks you a riddle. Right answer or humiliation? Total suspense.
events.ambush: 🏹 Goblins ambush you! You drive them off and keep their meagre loot.
events.bridge: 🌉 The suspension bridge gives way under your feet… sometimes you jump clear, sometimes you don't.
events.golem: 🗿 A stone golem blocks the way! You bring it down and plunder its hoard.
events.meteor: ☄️ A meteor crashes beside you! The crater is full of precious metals.
events.dragon: 🐉 A DRAGON! You survive its breath and grab part of its hoard.
events.caravan: 🐪 You join a merchant caravan: safety, supplies and good company.
events.herbalist: 🌿 A herbalist brews you a remedy that soothes your wounds.
events.waterfall: ⛲ You bathe under an icy waterfall and come out reinvigorated.
events.fireflies: ✨ Magical fireflies light your path and carry you onward.
events.well: 🪙 You toss a coin into a wishing well… and it pays you back a hundredfold!
events.hermit: 🧙 A wise hermit shares his soup and gives you an item from his collection.
events.eagle: 🦅 A giant eagle snatches you up and drops you miles down the road!
events.fairy: 🧚 A mischievous fairy sprinkles your road with magic dust.
events.portal: 🌀 An unstable portal swallows you and spits you out much further down the road!
events.fountain: ⛲✨ ULTRA RARE — The Fountain of Youth! You dive in and emerge fully regenerated. ❤️ FULL HEALTH!
events.elixir: 🌟 ULTRA RARE — You find the Celestial Elixir: body and mind fully restored. ❤️⚡ FULL EVERYTHING!
events.goldenvault: 🏆 ULTRA RARE — You crack open the Golden Vault: a mountain of coins is yours!
events.phoenix: 🔥 ULTRA RARE — A phoenix is reborn before your eyes and grants you its flames: nearly full health, plus a gift!
events.witch: 🧙‍♀️ A witch hands you a steaming potion… surprise effect: remedy or poison?
events.mimic: 🎁👅 A treasure chest! …It's a MIMIC! You fight it off and loot its guts.
events.ogre: 👹 An ogre blocks the path! It beats you up and picks your pockets before letting you through.
events.skeletons: 💀 Skeletons crawl out of an old graveyard! You smash them back to dust.
events.harpy: 🦅 A harpy swoops down screeching and flies off with your coin purse!
events.fog: 🌫️ Thick fog swallows the road. You wander in circles and lose ground.
events.willowisp: 🔥 A will-o'-the-wisp lures you off the trail… You chase it like a fool and get lost.
events.mermaid: 🧜‍♀️ A mermaid's song bewitches you. You wake up on the shore, behind where you were.
events.toll: 🌉 A troll guards the bridge: 'Toll!' You pay up, but you make fast progress beyond it.
events.smith: ⚒️ A traveling blacksmith patches you up and resupplies you for a few coins.
events.altar: 🩸 An ancient altar demands a blood offering… in exchange it spits out gold.
events.mushrooms: 🍄 You nibble on unknown mushrooms. Energy guaranteed… but were they edible?
events.wizard: 🧙 A wandering wizard teleports you with a snap of his fingers. Where to? Even he doesn't know.
events.raven: 🐦‍⬛ A messenger raven follows you for a while and drops a little gift.
events.giant: 🗿 A GIANT looms before you! You fight with all your might and plunder its stash.
events.griffin: 🦅✨ A griffin grabs you by the shoulder and drops you much further down the road!
events.timeloop: ⏳✨ ULTRA RARE — A time loop swallows you! You relive the same places… but emerge full of energy.
events.wishingstar: 🌠✨ ULTRA RARE — A shooting star grants your wish: fortune, strength and renewed spirit!
events.peddler: 🧳 A traveling peddler hails you! He offers his provisions at bargain prices — a deal to grab, it's him or the shop.
events.tavern: 🍺 You stop at a lively tavern: you eat, drink and set off refreshed (though the bill lightens your purse).
events.market: 🛒 A colourful market lines your path: you snag a useful item.
events.bear: 🐻 A bear bursts from the bushes! You escape, clawed but alive, and press on.
events.festival: 🎉 You stumble into a village festival: dancing, feasting and a few coins gifted!
events.serpent: 🐍 A giant serpent rears up in your path. The fight is fierce, but its scales are worth gold.
events.frost: ❄️ A biting cold sets in: you shiver, exhausted, and struggle to move forward.
events.oracle: 🔮 An oracle reveals a hidden shortcut: you gain a huge amount of ground.
events.knight: ⚔️ You find a fallen knight's hideout: his cache holds coins and an item.
events.ghost: 👻 A ghost haunts you and drives you back, chilled to the bone.

potion.name: 🧪 Healing potion
potion.desc: Instant +40 HP. Tastes awful, but it works.

ration.name: 🍖 Travel ration
ration.desc: Instant +15 HP and +20 ⚡. A walker's meal.

shop.title: 🧳 Road Shop
shop.bought: ✅ You buy and instantly use **{name}** ({effect}) for 🪙 **{price}**. New balance: 🪙 {balance}.

peddler.notYours: 🛑 This peddler is dealing with another traveler.

route.exhausted: 🥵 **Exhausted!** Your energy is negative: progress halved and damage amplified (×1.5). Rest up or use a provision.

duckling.title: 🐥 A duckling is following you!
duckling.rates: It takes **{steal}%** of your earnings, slows you by **{distance}%** and makes you take **{damage}%** more damage.
duckling.nothing: This time it got nothing from you.
duckling.turnsLeft: **{turns}** more event(s) before it gets bored.
duckling.gone: 🎉 It finally gets bored and waddles away!
duckling.total: Total loot since it started following you: **{coins}** coins.
